SkeinApiKey.description: API key of a Skein user (prefix ska_), created in the API keys section of the user's account.
SkeinApiKey.name: X-Skein-Api-Key

info.description: Public REST API of Skein. Every request authenticates with an API key of a Skein user; the permission an operation requires is listed in its security requirement.
info.title: Skein public API

get.description:
Returns the OpenAPI 3.1 document of this instance's public API: every operation, the right of an API key each one requires and the security scheme of the key.

The document is embedded in the server and is the same on every replica of a release. When the instance sets SKEIN_PUBLIC_API_URL, servers[0].url is that address; otherwise the document has no servers member.

No API key is needed; the request has no side effects.
get.summary: Get the OpenAPI document of the public API
